BALTIMORE BALLOT / A PUBLICATION BY EVERETT ANDERSON
:::

::: {.lead}
What did we approve? Who is responsible for carrying it out? And what actually changes for the people who live here?
:::

This publication starts with my 2026 ballot guide and follows the questions beyond Election Day: through budgets, public meetings, implementation decisions, and the evidence that follows.

[Explore the measure tracker](tracker.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Read the original ballot guide](guide/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

::: {.callout-note title="Opening research file"}
The first edition covers 12 ballot questions. The original guide is archived. Results are added only from certified records, and implementation claims require their own evidence. The tracker identifies records still awaiting verification.
:::

## The reporting approach

A recommendation is an opinion. An election result is a record. An implementation claim needs evidence. Each measure file keeps those distinctions visible, alongside the questions that still need answers.

[Read the research standards](methods.qmd).
